findings.message: The demo-info service is removed from the proposed recipe without PR-author confirmation that the removal is intentional. Per §3 recipe regression rules, dropping a services entry requires either restoration or explicit author confirmation in the PR discussion. Requested action: provide confirmation in the PR or restore the service.

summary: The trigger diff changes upload.directory from rocks/old to rocks/new at the same commit. The recipe snapshots differ only in the removal of the demo-info service (a disabled on-demand service). This removal is unconfirmed by the author and constitutes a recipe regression blocker.
